milestones.title: Core AI platform
milestones.detail: Muse Spark Open for always-on analysis and Muse Spark for decisions, behind one provider-agnostic client.

milestones.title: Screen and call awareness
milestones.detail: Notices meaningful screen changes, listens to speakerphone calls with speaker separation, and spots remote-access tools and copied payment details.

milestones.title: Scam-story tracking
milestones.detail: Follows each scam through its five stages, from the first pop-up to the money request.

milestones.title: Decision engine
milestones.detail: A dedicated judge weighs the whole session; safety limits in code decide what it may trigger.

milestones.title: Protective interventions
milestones.detail: Calm spoken nudges, a full-screen stop that can't be talked past, remote sessions ended, family PIN, trusted-helper allowlist.

milestones.title: Privacy and family alerts
milestones.detail: Account and card numbers hidden on the device, 24-hour retention, one clear alert for the family with a private incident page.

milestones.title: Quality testing
milestones.detail: Scam and look-alike scenarios, a generated screen library, and side-by-side comparisons on every release.

milestones.title: Faster stops
milestones.detail: Median time to stop cut from 46.5 s to 27.0 s; half of scams now stopped before money is even asked for.

milestones.title: Cloud service
milestones.detail: Hosted family dashboard and alerts on Google Cloud, with private storage and managed secrets.

milestones.title: Live demo: Can you scam Margaret?
milestones.detail: Anyone can play the scammer against Margaret, 78, and watch Tripwire stop them in real time.

milestones.title: Automatic recovery
milestones.detail: After a stop, Tripwire ends remote access, freezes the card, drafts the fraud report and tells the family.

milestones.title: No claim without evidence
milestones.detail: Every reason behind an action must quote what was actually said or done; unverified claims are discarded automatically.

milestones.title: Knows who is really in control
milestones.detail: Detects when mouse and keyboard input comes from a remote-access tool instead of the person at the computer: an observed fact, not a guess.

milestones.title: Family rules and payment holds
milestones.detail: Before a payment: allow, check with the person, hold for family approval, or stop. Plain rules the family chooses, alongside the AI; the stricter one wins.

milestones.title: Independent testing on real-world calls
milestones.detail: Measuring Tripwire on hundreds of scam and legitimate calls written by others, including real scam recordings.

milestones.title: Website and status page
milestones.detail: Product site, live demo and this status page.

milestones.title: Tripwire Sentinel: on-device AI
milestones.detail: A small open-weight Meta model (Llama 3.2 1B), fine-tuned on Modal, screens calls on the computer itself: works offline, costs nothing per call, and calls in the cloud judge only when something looks wrong.

milestones.title: Community Shield
milestones.detail: Scammer numbers, remote-access IDs and crypto addresses from every stopped scam protect all other homes, instantly. Never the protected person's own data.

milestones.title: Product walkthrough video
milestones.detail: A short film showing Tripwire stopping a scam from start to finish.
